title: Southwest Airlines Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Flight Searches
key_facts: Southwest launched a ChatGPT plugin on 6 Oct 2026
Described as first U.S. airline to do so; Virgin Atlantic launched one in April
Search and compare flights and all four fare types inside ChatGPT
Does not support Rapid Rewards points bookings
Booking and payment on Southwest.com via "Continue on Southwest"
ChatGPT may share relevant chats and memories with the plugin
Southwest calls it the first step in a multiphase approach
quote_evidence: Southwest Airlines has launched a ChatGPT plugin today, October 6, 2026 — the first U.S. airline to do so, though other carriers have their own AI tools that live on their websites, rather than inside ChatGPT.
However, you won’t finish the booking and pay for your ticket inside ChatGPT.
why_it_matters_hint: Airlines are appearing inside chat assistants, but booking still leaves the chat.
notes: Reporter tested searches; fares matched Southwest.com. "First US airline" is the outlet's claim.
